CustomField.description: True when the onboarding is Active, its target go-live date has passed, and it has not reached Go Live yet.
CustomField.formula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), NOT(ISBLANK(Target_Go_Live_Date__c)), Target_Go_Live_Date__c < TODAY(), OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Kickoff_Scheduled"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Gathering_Info"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Implementation"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "QA_Review") ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the target go-live date has passed and the onboarding is still active and not yet live.
CustomField.label: Is At Risk
